business_problem: FAIRTIQ needed a scalable, high-availability backend to process 320k+ trips/day across six countries, ensure near-zero downtime, support rapid growth, and handle noisy GPS-based data accounting.
solution_summary: FAIRTIQ needed a scalable, high-availability backend to process 320k+ trips/day across six countries, ensure near-zero downtime, support rapid growth, and handle noisy GPS-based data accounting. Built on MongoDB Atlas, FAIRTIQ leverages a cloud-native, microservices-ready platform offering flexible performance, high uptime (99.99%), and rapid deployment. Users simply check in via the FAIRTIQ app at the start of their journey. Check-in triggers sensor data collection, the app detects when the trip ends, and a journey mapping algorithm reconstructs the route using timetables, graph algorithms, and neural networks. Currently FAIRTIQ processes 320,000 trips daily and is available in eight European countries where it’s used actively by over 1.3 million people. Now expanding into new markets, the company’s goal is to simplify sustainable mobility internationally.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
solution_components.role: Lets FAIRTIQ query operational and archived data together from one interface.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the high-volume operational and event data that underpins FAIRTIQ's real-time analytics platform.

data_flow: Operational events, telemetry, or transaction data are ingested into MongoDB Atlas Data Federation and MongoDB Atlas, enriched or filtered where needed, retained for fast query access, and served to analytics, monitoring, or customer-facing workflows in near real time. Upstream and downstream integrations include AWS, ticketing systems, APIs.
